sql: SELECT TOP 10 tr.SearchTriggerValue AS keyword, pe.Name AS productName, ir.SearchItemValue AS productSku, ir.SearchItemBoostValue AS boostValue, r.SearchCatalogRuleId AS ruleId FROM dbo.ZnodeSearchCatalogRule r INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = r.PublishCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = pc.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeSearchTriggerRule tr ON tr.SearchCatalogRuleId = r.SearchCatalogRuleId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeSearchItemRule ir ON ir.SearchCatalogRuleId = r.SearchCatalogRuleId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe ON pe.SKU = ir.SearchItemValue AND pe.ZnodeCatalogId = r.PublishCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId WHERE p.StoreCode = @store AND r.IsPause = @notPaused AND (r.StartDate IS NULL OR r.StartDate <= @now) AND (r.EndDate IS NULL OR r.EndDate >= @now) AND tr.SearchTriggerKeyword = @triggerField AND ir.SearchItemKeyword = @itemField AND ve.RevisionType = @revisionType AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND ve.LocaleId = @localeId AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND ((@ruleEffect = @boostEffect AND ir.SearchItemBoostValue > @neutralBoost) OR (@ruleEffect = @buryEffect AND ir.SearchItemBoostValue < @neutralBoost)) AND (@keyword IS NULL OR tr.SearchTriggerValue = @keyword) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR ir.SearchItemValue = @preferred) ORDER BY r.SearchCatalogRuleId, ir.SearchItemRuleId, tr.SearchTriggerRuleId
